scope: Delivery playbooks, round 2 (epic cr-p3em): the critic's REVISE findings on Visual parity, Babysit and Shipping, fixed under the coordinator's rulings. The router lines are unchanged. No report and no upstream trait rows (README 4a's playbook exemption).
method: Critic review of round 2026-11-20-delivery-playbooks (3 blockers, 12 majors, 2 minors) and the coordinator's rulings on each: direct merge pinned to the verified head only, a stack snapshot and lease-pinned child move, verdict reuse on patch-id plus base tree, positive readiness, a stack-wide claim, wake before work, one visual pass predicate. Six round-1 trait definitions no playbook now holds were removed before commit; their replacements are new IDs.

subject: doc:.claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/visual-parity.md
why: Critic-107 fixes (M7, M8, M9, minor). One pass predicate, exact equality unless the request gives a metric and limit, judged at the primitive, component and land gates with the delta reported: visual-pass-predicate replaces zero-pixel-diff-gate as a playbook trait. The harness and baseline freeze once captured. visual-parity#4 gains integrated-tree-rediff (rerun affected or all states on the exact tree before land) and publish-requested-pr (push and open the pull request when authorized, URL or blocker in the reply); its condition is now a passing batch. visual-parity#5's closeout becomes visual-migration-closeout, which keeps failing diffs' images or their command. The reply gains a stopped-with-partial-proof exit.

subject: doc:.claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/babysit.md
why: Critic-107 fixes (M1-M6, minor). A new babysit#1 opens wake before any work when a deadline applies, open through closeout. babysit#2's lock becomes stack-wide-claim (one claim on the stack's bead from any entry; check claims nothing). babysit#3 reads a positive readiness predicate (positive-readiness-predicate replaces forge-merge-state-as-ready) and stops on a conflicted frontier (conflicted-frontier-stop). babysit#4 gains high-impact-finding-escalation. babysit#5 gains full-workflow-rerun-grant (drive only; gh run rerun of the whole run) and a fetched, error-aware stale-base test. babysit#6 runs on any publishable disposition, posts through the thread-reply endpoint from a JSON file and gains thread-replies-confirmed. babysit#7 gains event-wait-with-fresh-read with ready, advanced and complete outcomes. The reply gains a Stack complete exit.

subject: doc:.claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/shipping.md
why: Critic-107 fixes (B1-B3, M1, M10, M12). A new shipping#1 snapshots the stack (stack-snapshot-before-writes) and checks trunk for a queue rule. shipping#2 reuses a verdict only on equal verbatim patch-id, equal base tree and a bead record by the independent reviewer (verdict-reuse-on-patch-and-base-tree replaces patch-id-verdict-recheck). shipping#3 calls beads before the first bead write and gains verdict-posts-confirmed (keyed, read back, repaired). shipping#4 merges directly with --match-head-commit only (direct-merge-at-verified-head replaces auto-merge-only-on-covered-head; queues and auto-merge stop the run), moves a child with rebase --onto from the old parent tip and a lease pinned to the observed SHA (pinned-lease-child-move), and gains event-wait-with-fresh-read. The upstream sentence on bases moving to trunk is rewritten as a check before editing the base.
